summary: A hand-coded one-page variable-font poster: bands alternating acid lime and midnight navy, every line of copy animating along a custom SRFS (serif style) axis plus wght via CSS keyframes. It has no images; the deadpan copy ('a pig that grows Merino wool and lays eggs') and the morphing letters carry the page, ending in a three-slider tester.

instances.look: Tiny tracked caps note on navy above a hairline: 'This website uses variable fonts and CSS effects. It is optimized for Chrome and Safari.'
Centred stack on navy: 'SAY HELLO TO', then SERAPHS in heavy lime slab with a two-step hard shadow, then 'NOT YOUR AVERAGE TEXT FONT'
instances.feel: A circus barker's introduction: loud and a little mischievous
instances.ux: Static; there is no nav or CTA, the next lime band peeks in at the fold
instances.learn: A hard, stacked text-shadow in two colours turns a variable wordmark into a sign-painter's lockup using only CSS

reconstruction.layout: Three centred rows in 8px body margin: label row 227px, wordmark row 236px, label row 227px; about 690px in total on a 900px viewport
reconstruction.typography: Wordmark 274px (19vw) uppercase, SRFS 2 wght 200; labels ~50px box, visually ~28px caps, SRFS 0 wght 160, centred
reconstruction.behaviour: No motion; text-shadow 6px 6px 0 #0d1a26, 10px 10px 0 #0a9933 on the wordmark
reconstruction.content: 'Say hello to / Seraphs / Not your average text font'

instances.look: Alternating lime and navy bands, each holding one centred statement: 'Seraphs is like Jekyll and Hyde…', 'It is like a pig that grows Merino wool and lays eggs.', TRANSMUTATION, 'You can also use it for STATIC TEXT'
instances.ux: Each line loops between serif styles on its own timer as you scroll; 'STATIC TEXT' is the joke: the only line that doesn't morph, swept by a light glint instead
instances.learn: Let the copy describe the morph while it happens: a text about duality that changes its own serifs needs no explanation

reconstruction.layout: Full-width stacked bands 360-690px tall, alternating background; centred text with big vertical padding, no grid
reconstruction.typography: Statements ~115px, leading ~1.05, centred, sentence case; TRANSMUTATION 137px caps tracked 0.1em; 'You can also use it for' ~130px SRFS 0 wght 100; STATIC TEXT caps tracked 0.1em
reconstruction.behaviour: CSS keyframes on font-variation-settings, 5-7s ease-in-out infinite: LooperThree wght 200 SRFS 6 ↔ wght 160 SRFS 5; LooperTwo wght 200 SRFS 0 ↔ wght 100 SRFS 3; STATIC TEXT uses a 15vw gradient (#2b3b2b → #ccff33 → #2b3b2b) with background-clip:text sweeping in 2.5s (animation 'shine')
reconstruction.content: Wry analogies for a shapeshifter: Jekyll and Hyde, Bruce Banner and Hulk, the egg-laying wool pig

instances.look: Small sans paragraph on how the designspace was built beside LIGHT / BOLD at display size; then 'It has a weight axis and multiple serif styles that all interpolate:' with each line in another style; then 'From sans to Seraphs' huge and morphing
instances.ux: Static paragraph, looping headline; the 08 crop is nearly empty because its content landed in the top of the 09 crop
instances.learn: State the axis logic in one sentence whose lines are each set in the style they name, then demonstrate it with one looping phrase

reconstruction.layout: Row 1 (lime): two centred columns, paragraph ~230px wide at left, LIGHT/BOLD stacked at right, ~400px tall. Row 2 (navy): three centred lines ~560px tall. Row 3 (lime): two-line 701px band, text nearly edge to edge
reconstruction.typography: Paragraph ~24px body scale SRFS 0, tracked 0.025em, leading 1.4; LIGHT wght 100 / BOLD wght 200 at ~100px caps; statement lines ~115px, SRFS 0 / 3 / 6 line by line; 'From sans to Seraphs' ~290px sentence case
reconstruction.behaviour: 'From sans to Seraphs' loops the SRFS axis with LooperOne (wght 100 SRFS 0 ↔ wght 200 SRFS 6), 6.5-7s ease-in-out
reconstruction.content: Real note: 'Seraphs started with the idea to create a designspace using only a light and a bold master… expanded into 12 Masters'

instances.look: Three alternating bands (Light on navy, Regular on lime, Bold on navy), each a centred stack of six style names set in themselves: Sans, Seraphs, Slab, Wedge, Tuskan, Calligraphic
instances.feel: A roll-call: the same voice in six costumes
instances.learn: A family made of 6 serif styles × 3 weights reads clearly as three bands of six self-naming lines

reconstruction.layout: Three bands, each 861px tall (~96vh), six centred lines; line width varies with the name so the stack has a soft silhouette
reconstruction.typography: 115px, leading ~1.0, sentence case; wght 100 / 142 / 200 by band; SRFS 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 line by line
reconstruction.content: Style names only: 'Seraphs Sans Light … Seraphs Calligraphic Bold'

instances.look: Lime band, one centred sentence: 'Up to now Seraphs just speaks English, but the characterset will be extended.'
instances.feel: Candid, in the same humorous voice
instances.learn: A limitation can be a one-line display statement that keeps the page's tone

reconstruction.layout: 693px band, four centred lines filling ~88% of the width
reconstruction.content: A plain statement of the current Latin-only coverage

instances.look: A-Z and a-z set as five huge centred lines of spaced letters filling a navy band and a lime band, each letter morphing between serif styles
instances.feel: An alphabet book that won't sit still
instances.ux: Static to the eye but looping: every letter breathes through weight and serif style, so one screen shows all the designs
instances.learn: Animating the whole alphabet along the style axis replaces a glyph grid per style: one block shows every serif shape on every letter

reconstruction.layout: Two bands 1475px tall (1.64vh), five centred rows of five letters, each row ~260px tall, letters separated by word spaces
reconstruction.typography: ~260px, uppercase then lowercase, leading ~0.95, letter-spaces as plain spaces
reconstruction.behaviour: One span animates: LooperOne 6.5s ease-in-out infinite, wght 100 SRFS 0 ↔ wght 200 SRFS 6
reconstruction.content: Basic alphabet only (J is missing from the capitals row, a typo in the source)

instances.look: A typeset circus bill: ALPHABET, 'circus' arched on an SVG curve in heavy Tuskan with green offset shadow, BERLIN, 'Calligraphic influence'
instances.learn: An SVG textPath plus a Tuscan axis setting gets a period-poster lockup out of a live font

reconstruction.layout: 1275px centred column; arch ~1270px wide spanning the band, ALPHABET above, BERLIN and caption below
reconstruction.typography: ALPHABET ~120px SRFS 4 wght 200; 'circus' ~274px on textPath; BERLIN ~200px SRFS 0.3-5; caption ~90px bold
reconstruction.behaviour: text-shadow 2px 2px 0 #0d1a26, 3px 3px 0 #0a9933; keyframes LooperFour (SRFS 5 ↔ 4) and LooperSans (SRFS 1 ↔ 0), 5s infinite
reconstruction.assets: SVG arc path for the textPath

instances.look: Row of three thin sliders with green square thumbs (WEIGHT, SERIF, FONT-SIZE) above one editable line, 'Give it a try!', on lime
instances.feel: Small and unfussy: a late invitation to play
instances.ux: Dragging a slider rewrites font-variation-settings on the output and sets size in vw; click the line to type
instances.learn: Three sliders are enough when one axis has real range; a custom thumb in the page's accent colour is the only styling needed

reconstruction.layout: 506px lime band; slider row at the top, spanning the width with label + 150px track repeated three times; centred output below
reconstruction.typography: Labels ~14px caps, tracked, SRFS 0 medium; output default 7.6vw (109px), wght 140, SRFS 1, leading 0.97em
reconstruction.behaviour: form oninput: wght 100-200, SRFS 0-7 step 0.01, size 3-24vw; no reset, no presets

instances.look: The hero's SERAPHS wordmark repeated, a hairline, then one tiny tracked line of links
instances.learn: Repeating the hero lockup as the closer frames the page like a poster

reconstruction.layout: 368px wordmark band, then 80px line under a 1px lime rule, all centred
reconstruction.typography: Wordmark as in the hero, 274px; legal line ~12px caps tracked, link names heavier

instances.look: The only buy path is a tiny text link in the footer line: 'Buy Seraphs on FUTURE FONTS'
instances.ux: One inline link to the Future Fonts page
instances.learn: An exhibition-style microsite can leave selling to the distributor, at the cost of a very quiet CTA
